title: Origins: Grovesoul
description: An origin which is best suited for forests.
body:
# 🍃 **Grovesoul**

### 1.20.1
### **Impact 2**

_Living and breathing trees, leaf like spirits that glide gracefully._

# List of Powers

<details>
<summary>🍂 Leaflike Travel</summary>

You're able to walk through trees and leaves, phasing is exhausting however. Using your Primary whilst phasing will allow you to dash with little cooldown.
<details>
<summary>Info</summary>
This means you can chain dash through forests, your ultimate form of travel.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Info</summary>
Using your dash while gliding allows you to travel further than dashing normally.

</details>

</details>

<details>
<summary>🌳 Timbers</summary>

You craft more planks from logs, you naturally move faster around trees.

</details>

<details>
<summary>❤️‍🔥 Forest Fire</summary>

You take extra damage from being on fire, burning will exhaust you.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🌱 Delicate</summary>

You deal less damage to players and hostile mobs.
</details>

<details>
<summary>🪓 Harvest</summary>

You take more damage from axes.

</details>
